artifacts.synopsis: The Standing Judicial Commission sustained the complaint of TE Art Sartorius and six others against Presbytery of Siouxlands, finding that the Presbytery erred when it approved its Judicial Commission's verdict acquitting TE Gregory Lawrence of five charges related to Federal Vision theology and unconventional views on baptism and apostasy.
